leadText:
Professor Telesu (Japanese: テレス博士 Dr. Telesu) is a character of the day who appeared in A Crowning Achievement.

He is an archaeologist who was studying hieroglyphics near a lake full of that suffered a drought after an earthquake. According to the hieroglyphics, a Slowpoke needed to evolve into a to save the colony, but the in the lake kept on latching on to the Slowpoke and causing them to evolve into . His daughter's Slowpoke was able to make it, and was intelligent enough to lead the Slowpoke and Slowbro into an underground cave where water was plentiful.
